name: auth-flow-reset-password
title: Auth Flow Reset Password
description: A reset screen that measures strength in bits of entropy on a calibrated track and shows the password's makeup as colored tiles without revealing a character. It warns about reused or common passwords, points to the exact character where the confirmation differs, counts down the reset link and ends by listing the sessions it signed out.
author: Hyperblur <hello@hyperblur.dev>
